question: Find the full names and majors of members who attended an event with more than 20 attendees and also submitted an approved expense over $50 between September 1, 2019 and December 31, 2019. Return results ordered by expense cost descending.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  m.XCL_035 AS first_name,
  m.XCL_036 AS last_name,
  maj.XCL_031 AS major
FROM member AS m
JOIN major AS maj ON m.XCL_042 = maj.XCL_030
JOIN expense AS e ON m.XCL_034 = e.XCL_022
WHERE e.XCL_021 = 'true'
  AND e.XCL_020 > 50
  AND e.XCL_019 BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2019-12-31'
  AND m.XCL_034 IN (
    SELECT a.XCL_002
    FROM attendance AS a
    WHERE a.XCL_001 IN (
      SELECT a2.XCL_001
      FROM attendance AS a2
      GROUP BY a2.XCL_001
      HAVING COUNT(*) > 20
    )
  )
ORDER BY e.XCL_020 DESC

SELECT
  m.XCL_035 AS first_name,
  m.XCL_036 AS last_name,
  maj.XCL_031 AS major
FROM member AS m
JOIN major AS maj ON m.XCL_042 = maj.XCL_030
JOIN expense AS e ON m.XCL_034 = e.XCL_022
WHERE e.XCL_021 = 'true'
  AND e.XCL_020 > 50
  AND e.XCL_019 BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2019-12-31'
  AND m.XCL_034 IN (
    SELECT a.XCL_002
    FROM attendance AS a
    WHERE a.XCL_001 IN (
      SELECT a2.XCL_001
      FROM attendance AS a2
      GROUP BY a2.XCL_001
      HAVING COUNT(*) > 20
    )
  )
ORDER BY e.XCL_020 DESC

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT m.XCL_035 || ' ' || m.XCL_036 AS full_name, maj.XCL_031 AS major
FROM member AS m
INNER JOIN major AS maj ON m.XCL_042 = maj.XCL_030
INNER JOIN expense AS e ON m.XCL_034 = e.XCL_022
INNER JOIN attendance AS a ON m.XCL_034 = a.XCL_002
INNER JOIN event AS ev ON a.XCL_001 = ev.XCL_010
WHERE e.XCL_019 = 'Approved'
  AND e.XCL_020 > 50
  AND e.XCL_018 BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2019-12-31'
  AND ev.XCL_010 IN (SELECT XCL_001 FROM attendance GROUP BY XCL_001 HAVING COUNT(*) > 20)
ORDER BY e.XCL_020 DESC
